scope_note: Residual synthesis after the Meta Prineville direct-evidence audit. One medium-confidence unit conversion carries Meta's rounded 2024 facility-level water-withdrawal observation from megaliters to gallons because the shared direct register has no compatible annual-withdrawal metric. Three low-confidence county comparisons use the established 2005-2010 pre-opening feature match, exclude every selected-study county from a 20-county inverse-distance-weighted donor pool, and report finite fit-sensitivity envelopes; the employment envelope is especially wide. The comparisons are descriptive and do not attribute Crook County outcomes to Meta. No supplier, construction, payroll, household-spending, tax-abatement, public-service-cost or fiscal-net model is retained because local inputs and same-scope evidence are insufficient.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Canonical annual water-withdrawal metric, unrounded meter data, withdrawal source allocation, consumption, reuse, discharge and billing by facility

Withdrawal is not consumption; no site-specific consumption or discharge value is reported.

Later Meta expansions, Apple's separate campus and other concurrent county changes are not isolated.
The donor screen cannot exclude every unobserved treatment.
